tasks.subject: Collect full diff for second review
tasks.description: Capture the current full uncommitted diff after the first code-review fixes, including chat guard, shared body-size guard, estimator, and tests.

tasks.subject: Run second parallel code-review pass
tasks.description: Launch three review agents in parallel over the full current diff: reuse, quality/spec, and efficiency. Require clear findings with severity and file references.

tasks.subject: Resolve second-review findings
tasks.description: Apply any valid fixes from the second code-review pass, then run targeted verification commands and report the final state plainly.

tasks.subject: Team-protocol code-review until clean
tasks.description: Run the code-review step over the whole current guard diff, fix every valid finding, and rerun until the step reports clean.

tasks.subject: Team-protocol structure-code until clean
tasks.description: After code-review is clean, run structure-code over the whole current diff, fix every valid service-layer/reuse finding, and rerun until clean.

tasks.subject: Team-protocol improve-codebase until clean
tasks.description: After structure-code is clean, run improve-codebase over the guarded-request diff, apply every accepted/deepening candidate required by the protocol, and rerun until no new candidates appear.

tasks.subject: Commit and push current branch
tasks.description: Use cap workflow: detect branch, review working tree, stage everything present, create a conventional commit, fetch, and push the current branch without prompt unless a real conflict/rejection occurs.

tasks.subject: Deploy pushed build to Contabo
tasks.description: Find and run the repository deployment script for the Contabo/VPS deployment, then verify service/build status and public/runtime health.
